BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: SSRF is exploitable via network inputs where attackers control request parameters influencing server-side calls.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Exploitation is straightforward when user input is directly used to construct request endpoints without validation.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: An authenticated user or low-privileged actor can often supply crafted input to trigger SSRF.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: No additional user interaction is required once the malicious request is submitted.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: SSRF allows access to internal systems or services beyond the original application boundary.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Attackers can access sensitive internal data, metadata services, or restricted endpoints.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: SSRF may allow unauthorized modification of internal services or trigger unintended actions.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: Abuse of internal services or repeated requests can lead to denial-of-service conditions.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: SSRF exploitation techniques are well-known and easily reproducible with simple payloads.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: Input validation, allowlisting endpoints, and secure request handling are well-established mitigations.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability is clearly defined (CWE-918) and reliably detected by static analysis.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_ATTACK_VECTOR
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: The vulnerability remains exploitable through network-accessible interfaces in the deployment environment.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Environmental controls typically do not significantly increase exploitation complexity.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Attackers with basic access can still exploit SSRF if input is not validated.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_USER_INTERACTION
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: No user interaction is required in the target environment.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_SCOPE
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Impact extends beyond the application to internal systems and services.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_CONFIDENTIALITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Internal data exposure risk remains high in real-world deployments.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_INTEGRITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Unauthorized internal actions can compromise system integrity.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_AVAILABILITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Internal service disruption or resource exhaustion may occur.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: CONFIDENTIALITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Protection of internal systems and sensitive data is critical.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: INTEGRITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Preventing unauthorized internal operations is essential.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: AVAILABILITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Maintaining availability of internal services is critical for business operations.
